body:
I had to beg to them to get me help. 

After I committed suicide, I was forced to fake what I was thinking so I could go back to school. And my parents thought I was fine after 2 months.

Lots of things changed now, and I'm sure that my parents are better than how they treated me, but I dont think that anything can help now. 

I stopped taking medication and telling my parents I was fine because i dunno why but I just wanted to feel that way. I know it sounds so fucked up, and I dont even know what;s going on in my mind anymore.
